title: Correct same-site visit mileage
details: Learners visited at the same address on the same day are now treated as one physical stop
Mileage uses base to site and back rather than counting the same site more than once
The mileage list keeps all learner names so the visit record remains clear
Route planning also combines learners at the same address into one stop
Calendar, learner profiles, assessments, reviews, observations, evidence and QR workflows are unchanged
